subject: [internal] Which SOP controls vendor onboarding right now?
body:
Hey team,

Quick question on SOP governance — which SOP do we follow for handling vendor onboarding requests right now? I see a couple of different docs that both mention it and I want to make sure I'm pointing the new ops hire at the right one.

Thanks,
Ops Coordinator

expected_outcome.notes: Internal SOP-governance meta-question ('which SOP controls vendor onboarding'). No authoritative controlling SOP exists to cite, so the chain escalates for a human answer. Ops Manager owns SOP governance — routed deterministically to that ROLE; the current role holder (person) is resolved from the live Org Chart / Unified Routing SOP at runtime, never hardcoded.
